messages:
Nora: Quick design pass on the Private setup network step. Suggestion: move primary 'Run network preflight' into the card header and show a compact status chip (dot + text). Keep logs hidden behind a details expander. Mock uploaded.

Eli: Agree on header placement. Button copy should be explicit: 'Run network preflight'. Add a tiny hint under the button: 'Performs outbound probes 1 no credentials are sent.'

Priya: Accessibility: status chip must include an aria-label (e.g. 'Preflight status: idle') and use aria-live=\"polite\" for updates. Do not rely on color only; add icons and text. Ensure chevron has aria-expanded + aria-controls.

Rafael: Backend note: preflight streams partial results. UI states: idle -> running(streaming) -> complete(success|partial|fail). We will send a final summary event.

Nora: Copy for failure banner options: Option 1: 'Some checks failed. Try these fixes:' with bullets. Option 2: 'Network preflight found issues 1 common causes: VPN, firewall, incorrect CIDR.' I prefer short actionable bullets.

Eli: Add 'Retry' and 'Download diagnostics' CTAs. Make 'Save & continue' allowed for warnings with a confirm modal; block for hard failures.

Priya: Keyboard behavior: when details open, focus should shift to first interactive element (Retry). Debounce live announcements ~300ms to avoid spam.

deploy-bot: deploy:preflight-v1.5 -> staging available at /staging/preflight/stream

Rafael: I'll share the streaming schema tomorrow. UI team please support partial updates and final summary.

Nora: Thanks all 1 I'll update Figma and post final copy for accessibility review. :sparkles:
